name: Fab-Form Industries Ltd.
summary: Fab-Form Industries Ltd. develops, manufactures, and distributes technology to form concrete footings, columns, foundations, and walls for building structures in Canada and the United States. The company offers concrete forming products for the building industry. It also distributes Helix micro rebars; and Nudura insulated concrete forms in British Columbia. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Delta, Canada.
